title: Even-length parity language uses zero space
statement: The language of Boolean strings containing an even number of true bits is decidable with zero work-tape space: there are a natural-number constant $c$ and a finite Turing machine such that, on every input $x$, the machine halts with the one-bit output indicating whether $x$ belongs to that language, using at most $c\cdot 0=0$ work-tape cells under the stated space measure.
